title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.16416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. translated_title: 利用语言模型进化可执行流水线程序实现AutoML
translated_abstract: 自动机器学习（AutoML）系统在预先指定的预处理算子、学习器和超参数空间中搜索流水线：它们可以选择和调整已知组件，但无法在该空间之外产生结构。我们提出了LACE，一个AutoML框架，它转而搜索完整的可执行流水线程序：进化循环维护一个由scikit-learn兼容的Python类组成的种群，大型语言模型作为变异算子。据我们所知，LACE是首个以这种方式形式化通用表格流水线AutoML的框架，并在标准化OpenML任务上进行了评估，采用泄漏控制协议，该协议不向生成器提供数据集身份。由于每个候选都是普通Python代码，返回的流水线及产生它的搜索过程可以直接检查和编辑，而不仅仅通过框架的模型对象。在68个OpenML分类任务上，LACE w
tldr: LACE是首个通过进化循环和大型语言模型作为变异算子，直接搜索可执行Python流水线程序的AutoML框架，突破了传统预定义空间限制，并支持流水线直接检查和编辑。
en_tdlr: LACE is the first AutoML framework that searches over executable Python pipeline programs via an evolutionary loop with a large language model as the variation operator, breaking predefined space limits and enabling direct inspection and editing of pipelines.
